verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a Backend API that can be driven programmatically. A probe confirms a live OpenAPI spec at clerk.com/openapi.json, personal access tokens can be created for the Backend API, and endpoints such as GET /v1/logs are explicitly public for use 'from your own code or an AI agent'. The migration tool also creates users via the Backend API and respects its rate limits. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of endpoint coverage and reference depth in the pack; the frontend API is reported by a hands-on user as 'sparsely documented'.
